# Vendored gpui-base

This directory holds `gpui-base` 0.8.1 from crates.io, licensed under Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-APACHE`). Upstream: <https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit>, path `crates/base`, commit `99576db58ec8103417c41a092e891b4022d24e7e`. Triad's root `Cargo.toml` points at it with `[patch.crates-io]` and excludes it from the workspace, so it keeps its own lints and formatting.

The copy carries Triad's patch, listed below (PLAN.md §A6.1). Each changed file starts with a notice, as Apache-2.0 §4(b) requires. [gpui-kit-issues.md](../../docs/gpui-kit-issues.md) records why.

## Changes

- `RangeDecorationStyle::FullLine` fills every visual row a range touches across the full text width, over the active line, which shows through the translucent fill. Borders paint after both, so no row hides a frame. Only the focused editor paints the active line (`active_line_fill`), so beside other editors it marks where typing goes. `RangeDecorationStyle::Fill` paints only the text extent, so a short line gets a short band. Files: `src/input/editor/decorations.rs`, `src/input/base/element.rs`.
- `GutterMark` on a `RangeDecoration` draws a colour strip beside the rows the range touches and a label on the first visible one. `EditorState::gutter_marks(true)` reserves the column, between the line numbers and the fold icons. Files: `src/input/editor/decorations.rs`, `src/input/base/element.rs`, `src/input/base/state.rs`, `src/input/mod.rs`.
- Line labels: `EditorState::set_line_labels` shows a `LineLabels` column in the gutter, between the line numbers and the gutter marks. Each `LineLabel` covers a run of buffer lines: its text sits on the first visible row, and its hover card, from `LineLabel::with_tooltip`, shows anywhere over the run. Each visible label is a child element, laid out and prepainted with the line decorations and painted above the gutter background. `None` removes the column. Files: `src/input/editor/decorations.rs`, `src/input/base/element.rs`, `src/input/base/state.rs`, `src/input/mod.rs`.
- `RangeDecoration::with_border` draws a border inside a `FullLine` band, above the fills: one pixel wide, or as wide as `with_border_width` sets. Other styles ignore it. Files: `src/input/editor/decorations.rs`, `src/input/base/element.rs`.
- Spacer rows: `EditorState::set_spacers` puts blank, hatched rows above buffer lines, or after the last line, for two-way diff alignment (PLAN.md §A6.5). They belong to no line. `SpacerMap` sits above `FoldMap`, so display rows count them and every `DisplayMap` row query sees them. A spacer above a folded line is dropped while the fold lasts. Each laid-out line carries the spacer height above it, and the stacking loops in layout, paint and hit testing add it. A vertical move goes past spacers. A click on one lands at the start of the line below. Files: `src/input/editor/display_map/spacer_map.rs` (new), `src/input/editor/display_map/display_map.rs`, `src/input/editor/display_map/mod.rs`, `src/input/editor/display_map/text_wrapper.rs`, `src/input/base/layout.rs`, `src/input/base/element.rs`, `src/input/base/state.rs`, `src/input/base/movement.rs`.
- Spacer notes: `EditorState::set_spacer_notes` paints a line of italic text, in its own colour, on spacer rows. A `SpacerNote` names a buffer line; the notes for one line fill the spacer rows above it in order, one per row, and a line at or past the end means the rows after the last line. A note without a row does not show. A note may also fill its row, frame it with a one-pixel border and put a gutter mark beside it. Files: `src/input/editor/decorations.rs`, `src/input/base/element.rs`, `src/input/base/state.rs`, `src/input/mod.rs`.
- Tab stops: a tab that starts less than `ROUNDING` (0.01 px) short of a stop takes the next stop. Upstream's tab stops end such a tab on the stop it nearly reached, as a sliver: shaped glyph positions and the stop width round differently. File: `src/input/base/tab_stops.rs`.
- Line layout: `TextWrapper` reads the changed lines in one pass with `Rope::lines_at`, in place of a `slice_line` tree lookup per line. A font, wrapping-indent or tab-size change rebuilds the lines only when they wrap and have been prepared; unwrapped lines are one row each whatever the font or tab size. The editor sets its tab size on the first frame, so a rebuild there would build the 1M-line tree twice and free one: 91 MB more peak RSS. An unwrapped line is read by its length alone, from a scan of the rope's chunks for `\n`. At 1M lines the first frame takes about 30 ms: 21 ms to build the line tree, 12 ms of it in `SumTree::from_iter` (PLAN.md §A6.7). File: `src/input/editor/display_map/text_wrapper.rs`.
- Scroll bounce tests: a gesture over an editor or a `ScrollBounce` area keeps scrolling through packets whose f32 sums round, and a finger lifted inside the text throws no edge. Upstream fixes both; the tests guard the behaviour triad relies on. Files: `src/input/base/state.rs`, `src/scroll_bounce.rs`, `src/overscroll.rs`.
- Edit observer: `EditorState::set_edit_observer` takes an `EditObserver`, which gets every edit a code editor reports to its highlighter, as the highlighter gets it: one edit, or the edits of one change in the order applied, each with the text right after it. It gets them whether or not a highlighter is installed, so an application can record edits and keep the highlighter slot for syntax highlighting. A redraw is no edit and reaches no observer. Files: `src/input/base/mode.rs`, `src/input/base/state.rs`, `src/input/editor/highlighting.rs`, `src/input/mod.rs`.
- Search anchor: `set_search_query` positions the matcher at the top of the viewport for a changed query, but leaves the session's `anchor_offset` as `open_search` set it. gpui-component's search panel calls `set_search_query` on every key and re-shows itself, selecting its field, whenever the anchor changes; with the anchor rewritten on each call, every key replaced the one before. File: `src/input/editor/search.rs`.
- Idle cursor: a cursor rests, shown, once it has blinked for `IDLE_TIMEOUT` (10 s) without a key, a click or a focus; the next of these wakes it for another 10 s. A blinking cursor redraws the window every 500 ms, and while a window draws, the macOS Metal driver keeps about 115 MB in use; a window that draws nothing lets it reclaim that memory (PLAN.md §A6.7). File: `src/input/base/blink_cursor.rs`.
- A `TextView` test reads the crate's `README.md`. Upstream it reads the repository's, which the published crate lacks, so the crate's unit tests did not compile. File: `src/text/text_view.rs`.

Tests sit in `src/input/base/element.rs`, after the comments `Triad: full-line fills and gutter marks`, `Triad: line labels`, `Triad: spacer rows` (spacer notes among them) and `Triad: tab stops` (upstream's tab stops in an editor), in `src/input/base/state.rs` and `src/scroll_bounce.rs` after `Triad: rounding is not an edge`, in `src/input/base/blink_cursor.rs` after `Triad: an idle cursor rests`, in `src/input/base/state.rs` after `Triad: an inactive window shows no cursor` and `Triad: the edit observer` and `Triad: a query typed into the search panel keeps the panel's anchor`, in `src/overscroll.rs` after `Triad: a finger lifted inside the text throws nothing`, in `src/input/editor/display_map/text_wrapper.rs` after `Triad: one pass over the lines`, in `src/input/base/tab_stops.rs` after `Triad: a tab a rounding error short of a stop`, and in `src/input/editor/display_map/spacer_map.rs`. `script/checks` runs all the crate's unit tests:

```sh
CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/vendor cargo nextest run --manifest-path vendor/gpui-base/Cargo.toml --features test-support --lib
```
